correctness.rationale: Under n>=B>=2m>=2, rank k_N=B-mN and independent Gaussian quadratic forms, Var(g²)=2 makes exact MSE F_N=2T_N/N. Sorted nonnegative squared log eigenvalues define increasing block masses c_j. With T_N=T_0+sum_{j<=N}c_j, H_N=Nc_{N+1}-T_N satisfies F_{N+1}-F_N=2H_N/[N(N+1)] and H_{N+1}-H_N=(N+1)(c_{N+2}-c_{N+1})>=0. Hence minimizers are consecutive and one probe is optimal iff F_1<=F_2; all ties and nondivisible budgets are accounted for. Exact geometric sums produce q^(-m)+q^(n-B+m)>=2 and limiting q^m<=1/2. Independently checked 2,690 rational decreasing spectral-weight profiles; analytic identities, not testing, prove all n.
